insights.one_liner: Swiss luxury group behind Cartier and Van Cleef & Arpels; its one listed job here is an English-language data internship in Amsterdam.

culture.text: A Swiss luxury group owning jewellery and watch brands such as Cartier and Van Cleef & Arpels.
A big company: Wikidata lists about 19,137 employees (no year given) and headquarters in Bellevue, Geneva.

open.text: Its one current opening here, a data and analytics internship in Amsterdam, does not ask for Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so a work visa through this employer is not straightforward.

growth.text: Wikidata lists revenue of €14.238 billion, net profit of €600 million and operating income of €3.191 billion, with no year given.

worth_knowing.text: Richemont named Anton Rupert, son of chairman Johann Rupert, co-deputy chairman as part of its succession plan.
A Cartier veteran was appointed to lead Richemont's leather brand Delvaux.
